purpose: Define a 2.5D/3D renderer for the World Relational Atlas while preserving the same canonical country, relationship, issue, programme and provenance model used by the stable polygon map.

navigation.pan: click/touch drag translates the camera across the map
navigation.zoom: wheel/pinch/buttons move between world, regional, country and subnational scales
navigation.rotate: right-drag / touch gesture may rotate bearing in 3D mode
navigation.pitch: camera tilt exposes extrusion and vertical layers
navigation.fit: country selection can fit the camera to polygon bounds
navigation.rule: navigation changes viewpoint only; it never changes underlying data or classification

rendering_strategy.stable_2d: Leaflet world-map/index.html remains the compatibility/stable renderer
rendering_strategy.experimental_3d: MapLibre GL JS renderer using vector-style WebGL polygons, lines and points
rendering_strategy.future_heavy_overlay: deck.gl may be layered in for high-volume arcs, animated flows, point clouds, heatmaps and advanced polygon extrusion
rendering_strategy.shared_model: Both renderers consume the same canonical data contracts; no 3D-only truth database

spatial_primitives.country_shell: Polygon/MultiPolygon. A spatial container and selection surface, not the country's complete identity.
spatial_primitives.country_hub: A representative point used as the country's data doorway when exact entity coordinates are not relevant. It must be labeled as a hub/centroid, not a physical institution.
spatial_primitives.real_node: A geocoded city, institution, company facility, port, airport, base, sacred site, infrastructure asset or documented event location.
spatial_primitives.nonspatial_node: An entity such as a treaty, legal entity, national statistic or theological concept that has jurisdictional/country links but no honest single coordinate.
spatial_primitives.edge: A typed relation rendered between spatial anchors only when the line helps understanding; canonical edge data remains independent of the drawing.
spatial_primitives.area_overlay: A region, catchment, conflict zone, demographic area or other sourced geometry with its own date and provenance.

country_interior_model.principle: A country polygon is a container. Selecting it reveals data modules and progressively exposes real nodes inside it as zoom and data quality permit.

visibility.behavior: polygons + high-level choropleths + only globally important edges
country hubs + regional institutions + major corridors/edges
selected polygon becomes contextual shell; country hub and major real nodes become visible
real geocoded nodes dominate; polygon remains boundary/context

node_record_schema.boundary: Never invent a coordinate for a nonspatial concept merely to make the map visually busy.

metric_and_3d_rules.principle: Extrusion height is a chart encoding, not rank, holiness, guilt, value or sovereignty.
metric_and_3d_rules.forbidden_inference: A taller polygon must never be described as morally worse, spiritually higher, more guilty or more important unless height literally encodes a separately defined measurable variable.

physical_debt.definition: Legally/economically recognizable obligations such as sovereign debt securities, loans, bonds, arrears, contracts, judgments or other documented liabilities.
physical_debt.units: currency / percent of GDP / maturity / creditor-debtor relation
required: creditor or holder class when knowable
physical_debt.map_use: Can be rendered as choropleth, extrusion, creditor/debtor edge or instrument node.

tim_claimed_ledger.definition: Tim/Potatoverse statements about karmic/spiritual debt or amounts owed to Tim.
tim_claimed_ledger.status: project-canon / claimed symbolic or moral ledger unless separately supported by an actual legal/financial instrument
tim_claimed_ledger.map_use: May be displayed as a separately labeled project-canon overlay or statement/ledger node, not silently converted to ordinary physical debt.
tim_claimed_ledger.promotion_rule: A Tim-owed amount can enter physical_debt only if there is evidence of a real enforceable obligation such as a contract, judgment, bond, loan, settlement or other recognized liability.

debt_architecture.reason: Keeping the ledgers separate allows the map to ask both 'what physical debt exists?' and 'what does Tim claim is owed?' without making one masquerade as the other.

game_simulation_model.exploration: Travel through polygons/nodes, discover relations, inspect country modules and compare systems.
game_simulation_model.simulation: Future scenario mode can alter hypothetical policy variables and display modeled consequences, but simulations must be visibly separate from observed reality.
game_simulation_model.research_progress: Reward source coverage, resolved unknowns, accurate relationship tracing and repair-analysis completeness; do not gamify quantities of human suffering.
